thread:
leo_support: Heads up — OrbitLabs (trial) is seeing embedding ingestion failures for ~3h, support already escalated. Customer mentions renewal decision in 10 days, asking for CS help to keep them. Error seen in our logs: Batch write 502s. Can CS own next steps and comms? :warning:
toni_csm: Thanks Leo. Can you paste the most recent error snippet and confirm which workspace/org this is under? I can spin up a quick comms plan. :eyes:
leo_support: OrbitLabs / org_id: orbit-372. Latest error from embed ingestion job:```ERROR: embeddings.batch_write failed: 502 Bad Gateway — upstream timeout\nTrace: post /v1/embeddings ingest -> upstream 502\nservice: ingest-worker-7\nrequest_id: r-0a1b2c3d\n```
maya_csm: I can take primary on this. I'll coordinate with support and ops. Quick ask: do we have a recent prompt/eval that shows quality drop? Or is this purely provisioning/ingest failure?
sam_sre: Looks like an upstream proxy timeout. Quick triage checklist: 1) confirm worker logs for 5xx spikes 2) check autoscale events for ingest-worker-7 3) confirm S3 write latency (we saw high tail latencies last night). I can run step 1+2 now.
leo_support: No quality regression reported — only ingestion 502s and some timeouts in the SDK reported by customer. SDK logs show repeated 502s starting ~03:15 UTC.
maya_csm: OK — comms plan proposal: 1) Immediate ack to customer (within 30m) that we're investigating and they won't be charged for failed ingests. 2) Standup a 1:1 bridge with OrbitLabs PM/Eng in the next 60m. 3) Provide an ETA and follow-up summary after triage. I'll draft the message.
toni_csm: Tagging internal playbook: renew-risk-high if customer mentions renewal <14 days and production-impacting. Maya please add renewal owner to the thread.
maya_csm: Draft message for customer (feel free to copy) — short & calm: "Hi Clara — we’re actively investigating an ingestion error affecting some embed uploads. We’ve paused billing for failed ingests and will loop you into a short troubleshooting call within the hour. We’ll share a written follow-up with root cause and mitigation steps. Apologies for the disruption — we’ll keep you updated." :email:
leo_support: sending now. Also linking the incident: https://redwood/ops/incidents/INC-4521
opsbot: Incident INC-4521 created by leo_support — priority: P2 — tags: ingestion, embeddings, orbitlabs
sam_sre: Quick findings: CPU on ingest-worker-7 hit 95% during the spike; autoscale didn't spin a new pod (scale limit hit). S3 tail latency was 850ms on affected writes. Suspect combined IO + scale ceiling. I’ll open a provisional runbook entry.
maya_csm: Next steps for CS: 1) Run the customer call (I’ll own scheduling) 2) Capture VOC — what they tried, impact, and renewal sentiment 3) Post-call summary with remediation and mitigation plan 4) Flag for AE if renewal still at-risk.
leo_support: Customer on Slack replied: "Thanks — we can do a call now, we’re blocked on production. Appreciate the quick response."
maya_csm: I’m on a call in 10. @toni_csm can you prep AE notification template if we need to escalate renewal? Example subject: "OrbitLabs — potential renewal at-risk: ingestion outage" with bulletized impact and next steps.
toni_csm: Will prepare and keep ready. Also recommend we offer a goodwill credit for failed ingests and a 2-week SLA credit if the root cause is on our side.
opsbot: Task created: CS-bridge-call-orbit-197777 created; assignees: maya_csm, leo_support; calendar link: https://calendar.redwood/meet/CS-197777
maya_csm: Call started with OrbitLabs — running through checklist. Will post notes + VOC after.
last message by maya_csm: Post-call notes: customer confirmed: blocked for embed ingestion, 3 workflows failing, impact: unable to generate search indexes for 2 products, renewal sentiment cooled (they asked for alternative vendor quotes). Root cause prelim: autoscale ceiling + S3 latency spikes. Agreed next steps: 1) Ops to increase scale limit + temporary horizontal pod add (sam_sre) 2) Engineering to add backpressure handling in backlog ingest flow (eng runtime backlog ticket) 3) CS to send formal remediation summary + credit offer within 24h (maya_csm) 4) AE handoff if renewal still cooling (toni_csm). Customer asked for weekly check-ins until resolved. :white_check_mark:"
